content: अंशुमत् {%a.%} [अंशु-अस्त्यर्थे मतुप्] .²1 Luminous, radiant; ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् <ls>Bg. 10. 21</ls>. .²2 Pointed. .²3 Fibrous, abounding in filaments (<ab>Ved.</ab>) {%m.%} (˚मान्) .²1 The sun; वालखिल्यैरिवांशुमान् <ls>R. 15. 10</ls>; अंशुमानिव तन्वभ्रपटलच्छन्नविग्रहः <ls>Ki. 11. 6</ls>; जलाधारोष्विवांशुमान् <ls>Y. 3. 144</ls>; rarely the moon also; ततः स मध्यंगतमंशुमन्तं <ls>Rām. 5. 5. 1</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the grandson of Sagara, son of Asamañjasa and father of Dilīpa. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a mountain; ˚मत्फला <ab>N.</ab> of a plant, कदली Musa sapientum or Paradisiaca. .{@-ती@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant सालपणीं (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>डवला, सालवण</ns>) Desmodium Gangeticum. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the river Yamunā.
